data.title: Credential Spray Single Password
data.description: Detects password spraying attacks where a single password (or small set of passwords) is tested across many accounts. Unlike traditional credential stuffing which uses unique username-password pairs, password spraying tries common or recently breached passwords against a large account population to avoid per-account lockout thresholds.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Credential Spray Single Password")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct username) by password_hash > 20 and count(distinct password_hash) by source_ip < 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs event_type="login_attempt" auth_result="failure"
| stats dc(username) as unique_username by password_hash
| where unique_username > 20
| stats dc(password_hash) as unique_password_hash by source_ip
| where unique_password_hash < 3

falsepositives: Batch account creation workflows where a default password is assigned to many accounts
Automated test frameworks using a shared test password across test accounts
